Original Decipher card face for [[Tatooine: Mos Espa (Dark)]], rotated losslessly from the archive scan [[:File:Tat-D-tatooinemosespa-decipher-archive.jpg]] so the location reads landscape.

Source: [http://decipher.com:80/starwars/cardlists/tatooine/dark/images/tatooinemosespaD.jpg tatooinemosespaD.jpg], Decipher.com card list. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20020822035737/http://decipher.com:80/starwars/cardlists/tatooine/dark/images/tatooinemosespaD.jpg Internet Archive], 22 August 2002. SHA-256 of the archived file: e74b02138cc1ecc4ed1224dba03ae5bb5c1d56f8eb933c2e8f20a78c48326ab3.

Edits: rotated losslessly from the archive scan (jpegtran -trim -rotate 270 -copy all; JPEG data rotated without recompression). jpegtran drops the partial 8-pixel block at one edge (1 pixel column of black border); no other change.

The Holotable face [[:File:Tat-D-tatooinemosespa.gif]] is a separate file and is not replaced by this file.

Fair use rationale: this is a low-resolution image of a copyrighted Star Wars Customizable Card Game card, © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc. It is used only to identify and discuss the card on this non-commercial fan wiki, it does not replace any product sold today, and no free equivalent exists.
